skill.name: appflowy-api
skill.description: An AppFlowy Cloud and GoTrue automation skill for authentication, workspace discovery, document updates, database operations, search, and collab repair.
skill.summary: Automates authenticated AppFlowy API tasks with scripts and reference templates.
skill.author: BaloneGit

security_audit.summary: The skill is not malicious and no prompt injection attempt was found, but it deliberately performs authenticated AppFlowy network operations and handles credentials. Most static reconnaissance, certificate-key, shell-backtick, filesystem, and obfuscation findings are false positives from documentation, identifiers, stdin reads, or fixed helper invocations. The main risks are plain HTTP/private endpoint examples, command-line credential exposure, opt-in .env parsing, token output, and destructive collab updates.

remediation.issue: Plain HTTP and private IP examples
remediation.suggestion: Replace concrete HTTP addresses with placeholders, document HTTPS requirements, and require users to supply their own endpoint.
Prefer secure prompts or secret stores, redact token output, and remove password examples that persist in shell history.
Document the exact keys read, reject unexpected keys, and warn before reading files outside the project or skill directory.
Add dry-run output, backups, and confirmation for cleanup, rebuild, block deletion, and row deletion operations.

semantic_findings.title: Plain HTTP Credential Flow in Examples
semantic_findings.description: The quick start shows a password-grant request over HTTP, and the example config uses the same HTTP endpoint. Credentials could be intercepted or sent to the wrong host.

semantic_findings.title: Command-Line Credentials and Token Output
semantic_findings.description: The token script accepts a password on the command line and prints the token response to stdout. Shell history, process listings, or logs can expose credentials and bearer tokens.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The script directly defines --password and prints the login response. The documentation also demonstrates password arguments in shell commands.

semantic_findings.title: Destructive In-Place AppFlowy Updates
semantic_findings.description: The automation can delete blocks, remove row orders, and rebuild Grid sections while authenticated. Running it against the wrong view can cause AppFlowy data loss.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited files explicitly describe deleting old Grid blocks and implement row/block deletion updates. The behavior is intentional but risky for production workspaces.

content.value_statement: AppFlowy API work often needs repeated authentication, workspace discovery, and database updates. This skill provides scripts and references for authenticated AppFlowy Cloud automation.
actual_capabilities: Fetches GoTrue access tokens with email and password credentials.
Lists AppFlowy workspaces, databases, row IDs, and row details.
Creates page views and appends blocks from payload files.
Applies Grid templates, adds fields, and upserts database rows.
Runs health checks against GoTrue, AppFlowy, and workspace endpoints.
Uses Node Yjs helpers to update collab document state.
limitations: Targets AppFlowy Cloud 0.12.3 and may need changes for other versions.
Requires valid AppFlowy credentials or a bearer token before most actions.
Some workflows modify or delete existing document and database content.
Collab repair helpers require Node.js and the Yjs dependency.

use_cases.title: Build AppFlowy Integrations
use_cases.description: Authenticate with GoTrue and call AppFlowy workspace, document, database, and search endpoints.

use_cases.title: Check Workspace Automation Readiness
use_cases.description: Check service health, version compatibility, workspace access, and database availability before automation runs.

use_cases.title: Maintain Structured Planning Grids
use_cases.description: Create or update AppFlowy Grid views from templates while mapping fields, rows, dependencies, and subtasks.

prompt_templates.title: Check My Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the appflowy-api skill to explain which endpoint and credential values I need before running a health check.

prompt_templates.title: List Workspace Data
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan commands that list my workspaces, databases, row IDs, and row details for a selected workspace.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a Grid Template Safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my Grid template workflow, identify any destructive steps, and suggest a dry-run sequence first.

prompt_templates.title: Repair Collab State
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to analyze an AppFlowy collab cleanup plan, including block deletion, row order repair, and rollback needs.

output_examples.input: Check my AppFlowy deployment before using automation.
output_examples.output: A health summary with GoTrue status, AppFlowy status, workspace access, and version mismatch warnings.

output_examples.input: Prepare a safe Grid template update for a project plan.
output: A list of fields and rows that will be updated.
A warning about cleanup or rebuild actions.
A recommendation to test on a copied workspace first.

output_examples.output: A readable explanation of workspace, database, row ID, and row detail calls needed to inspect the issue.

best_practices: Use HTTPS endpoints and replace all example addresses before running commands.
Use least-privilege accounts and avoid writing tokens to shared logs.
Run cleanup modes on test workspaces before using production data.
anti_patterns: Do not run examples unchanged against the bundled private IP address.
Do not paste production passwords into shared terminals or notebooks.
Do not rebuild grids on important documents without a backup.

faq.question: Does this skill connect to AppFlowy Cloud?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses user-supplied AppFlowy and GoTrue endpoints for authenticated API calls.

faq.question: Can it work with self-hosted AppFlowy?
faq.answer: Yes. It is written for self-hosted AppFlowy Cloud 0.12.3 endpoints.

faq.question: Does it read .env files automatically?
faq.answer: No. The scripts read a .env file only when an --env path is provided.

faq.question: Can it change existing documents?
faq.answer: Yes. Grid cleanup and collab helpers can update or delete existing AppFlowy content.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: What should I configure first?
faq.answer: Set base URL, GoTrue URL, client version, and credentials or a bearer token.
